about: Hand saw at the workbench, the start (client/workbench/WorkbenchWork; written by tools/author-hand-saw-actions.mjs): played once, 0.7 s, then tool/hand_saw_rip. The body steps to the stand anchor before the log on the top and faces into the bench (approach), the head down to the cut; the saw comes up from beside the right hip into the kerf at the back of a stroke, the left hand goes to the log's left side. What the player holds is not drawn (held_item hidden: the saw is drawn from its own item, carried anywhere). docs/gameplay/afl_workbench_v1_design.md 17
